adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, when a `destinationCalendar` entry has no `credentialId`, the code falls back to `destinationCalendarCredentials.map(async (c) => await createEvent(c, event))` without passing the destination’s `externalId` (third arg). In `packages/core/CalendarManager.ts`, `createEvent` now returns `externalId` from that argument, and `EventManager` later uses `result.externalId` for `externalCalendarId` in references—so this path yields `externalCalendarId` as undefined/null. Separately, `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` now selects the calendar via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId` and falls back to `"primary"` if not found. If the destination calendar object(s) lack `credentialId`, Google event creation will write to `primary` rather than the configured `externalId`. This is a behavior regression compared to the prior single-object `destinationCalendar.externalId` logic.
